description: Numerical Assessment and Validation of Wind Energy Potential for Electricity Generation in Zambia is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley. Evaluation and assessment of wind energy potential in Lunga District, Luapula Province, Zambia. Coverage: Zambia. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley. The repository dates the deposit 2023; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
